Khamoshi wisdom ke liye jagah banati.
Agar tumhe darr mehsoos nahi hota, tum brave nahi ho sakte.
99 baar haar, 100vi baar jeet – yehi lagan hai.
Courage—fear ko ek minute aur pakad ke rakhna.
Himmat ek muscle hai; use se badhti.
Dusron ki opinions humein define na karein—yeh decide karein.
Asli taqat khamosh hoti hai.
Dobara shuru karne ki himmat.
Chalo rise karein aur thankful banein.
Khamoshi zindagi hai.
Grit wahi lagan hai jab duniya kehti hai ruk jao, tab bhi aage badhte rehna.
Himmat sahi kaam karna hai.
Khamoshi Khuda ki zubaan hai.
Grit kabhi na khatam hone wali koshish.
Tera faith fear se bada hona chahiye.
Sahan-shakti grit ki kunji hai.
Fear ke bina courage rare hai.
Mehnat rang lati hai.
Himmat fear ke upar bridge hai.
